# Sirach Chapter 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 15 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_015_page_001.jpg

---

**15:1** All of this is for those who fear the LORD — those who hold fast to the law will find wisdom.

**15:2** She will come to meet them like a mother, and welcome them like a young bride.

**15:3** She will feed them with the bread of understanding and give them the water of wisdom to drink.

**15:4** They will lean on her and not fall; they will trust in her and not be put to shame.

**15:5** She will raise them above their neighbors, and give them words to speak in the assembly.

**15:6** They will find joy and a crown of gladness, and will inherit a name that lasts forever.

**15:7** Foolish people will never find her; sinners will never catch a glimpse of her.

**15:8** She stays far from the arrogant, and liars never think of her.

**15:9** Praise sounds wrong coming from the lips of a sinner — God never gave it to them.

**15:10** True praise comes from wisdom, and the LORD makes it flourish.

**15:11** Don't say, "God is the reason I went wrong" — he doesn't do what he hates.

**15:12** Don't say, "He led me astray" — he has no use for a sinful person.

**15:13** The LORD despises everything abominable; those who fear him feel the same.

**15:14** He himself made human beings from the very beginning, and left them in the power of their own free choice.

**15:15** If you want to, you can keep the commandments — keeping faith is entirely your own decision.

**15:16** He has set fire and water before you: reach out your hand to whichever you choose.

**15:17** Life and death lie before every person; whichever one you desire is what you will receive.

**15:18** For the wisdom of the LORD is immense; he is mighty in power and sees everything.

**15:19** His eyes are on those who fear him; he knows everything that anyone does.

**15:20** He has never commanded anyone to be wicked; he has never given anyone license to sin.
